headline: Ski MaskThe Slump God was arrested following a traffic stop by the Florida Highway Patrol
body: Ski MaskThe Slump God was arrested following a traffic stop by the Florida Highway Patrol and is facing DUI and reckless driving charges. Swipe to see his reaction to the arrest, shortly after getting home. He was booked into Broward County Main Jail on September 17, 2026. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

🚨 Ski MaskThe Slump God was arrested following a traffic stop by the Florida Highway Patrol and is facing DUI and reckless driving charges.

👉 Swipe to see his reaction to the arrest, shortly after getting home.
 
He was booked into Broward County Main Jail on September 17, 2026.

According to his charges, he faces multiple DUI counts involving alleged damage to property or another person, reckless driving charges involving damage, and a charge for operating a motor vehicle without a valid license.
